course.title: Node.js — Complete Practical Backend Course
course.description: A deep practical Node.js course from runtime fundamentals through core APIs, HTTP servers, asynchronous programming, Express, security, testing, production practices and real learning-platform backend projects.
learningOutcomes: Build student enrollment, progress and submission APIs.
Design a production-ready learning platform backend.
